Accessibility

Choose the information and controls that work for you.

Non-visual racing

Use a screen reader for menus and spoken race feedback, with DRIVE BY EAR for spatial steering and corner cues. Blank screen removes the visual scene while you drive.

Your controls

Choose device rotation, on-screen steering or keyboard input. Left-handed controls swap sides. RECALIBRATE sets a comfortable neutral angle. Tutorial steering help supports learning the drive pad.

Visual comfort

Choose System, Light or Dark appearance. Color Cues add spoken colour information. Camera and graphics settings help you find a comfortable, readable view.

Learn with sound

Bring Sound balance toward DRIVE BY EAR for clearer guidance. Start at a comfortable speed and distinguish the warm ribbon from engine, tyre and surface sounds.
